title: Regulatory Dossier Assistant
short: Checks a registration dossier for missing and inconsistent sections before it reaches the authority.
symptom: Registration files come back with deficiency letters
ingredient: A completeness checker for CTD dossiers
directions: Upload the dossier index and key documents. Get a gap list against the CTD structure and local requirements, with cross-document inconsistencies highlighted.
problem: Dossiers are large and assembled by many people, so missing documents and inconsistent data between modules are common.
why: Each deficiency letter can delay a product launch by months.
solution: Maps the dossier to the CTD structure and the target authority’s checklist, flags missing items, and compares key data such as strengths, shelf life and storage conditions across documents.
limitations: Local requirements change and must be kept up to date
Regulatory judgment and sign-off stay with the specialist
data: CTD/eCTD structure and the target authority’s checklist
review: The regulatory specialist reviews every gap and signs off the submission.
